heading: Sweet or savory
lede: Waffles go with almost anything. Select a section to slide it open and see how to serve it.

items.name: Butter and maple syrup
items.description: The classic. Melted butter sinks into every square while warm maple syrup pools in the pockets.
items.tip: A pinch of flaky salt on top

items.name: Berries and whipped cream
items.description: Fresh, tart berries cut through soft whipped cream for a light, bright finish.

items.name: Fried chicken and hot honey
items.description: Crisp, salty chicken on a crisp waffle, finished with a sweet and spicy drizzle.

items.name: Egg, bacon and cheddar
items.description: A soft fried egg and crisp bacon on a waffle with sharp melted cheddar make a hearty breakfast.

narration: Waffles work with sweet and savory toppings.
Go sweet with butter and maple syrup, or berries and whipped cream.
Or go savory with fried chicken and hot honey, or egg, bacon and cheddar.
